statement: GlobalWafers reports its 300mm, 200mm and 150mm lines have effectively reached maximum utilization, with supply constraints emerging on some advanced 300mm products
why: The raw silicon wafers that every AI chip and memory die starts from are now sold out, which caps how much AI silicon can be made regardless of fab capacity.

impact.mechanism: With wafer lines at full utilization, incremental demand from AI logic, HBM, silicon photonics and advanced packaging cannot be met without new capacity, pushing out upstream lead times.

evidence.excerpt: orders have surged from AI semiconductors, HBM, silicon photonics and advanced packaging demand

confidence.basis: Secondary outlet relaying a wire summary of an earnings call; no primary transcript or filing fetched.
